external_rotation_observation.population: Videos on vendor-served selected creator channels with title/thumbnail snapshots tracked in the first seven days after upload
external_rotation_observation.detection_algorithm: At least two packaging combinations, at least two returns to previously dropped combinations, no more than three observed titles or thumbnails; patterns identified from external sampled public states.
external_rotation_observation.settled_detection_rule: one observed version remains for >=24 hours before seven-day tracking ends
external_rotation_observation.source_authorship: Vendor article identifies writer as its AI strategist; no independent raw-level validation or owner Analytics confirmation.
limitations: Public switching can be caused by manual edits, localized thumbnails, cache/personalization, or missed snapshots; detected rotation cannot definitively prove a native test.
Vendor-tested population is selected approved/served creator channels, not a probability sample of all YouTube videos or creators.
The detected 460 of 75,998 edited videos is not a share of all platform videos using YouTube's official testing tool; first-week window misses later runs.
A final displayed variant is not necessarily the platform-declared statistically significant winner, since creators can manually stop, edit and choose.
Twenty-and-a-half hours is the vendor-observed rotation interval, not a YouTube Studio guaranteed time to significance.
Different subscriber bands may differ in access, testing propensity, channel activity and vendor observability; no random test assignment or causal sales result.
No tested thumbnail images, creator identity or private owner data were copied into Mercata.
